## Project Guidelines

This is a Nuxt3 project with Tailwind CSS integration.

- Use Vue 3 Composition API for components
- Follow Nuxt3 best practices and conventions
- Organize components in `/components`, pages in `/pages`, and composables in `/composables`
- Use Tailwind CSS utility classes for styling
- Keep configurations in `nuxt.config.ts`
- Use TypeScript for type safety

## Development Conventions

- Component names should be PascalCase
- Use `<script setup>` in Vue components
- Organize imports alphabetically
- Follow Vue 3 and Nuxt3 documentation
